Players Committee card image of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to activate 1 Force (or to ▲ [A New Hope] R2-D2). During your control phase, if with a Rebel at an interior mobile battleground, opponent loses 1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/c_3po.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/c_3po.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
